lines: 1 file does not match what the tracked files build:

The output in the checkout was built from this working tree right before (--fresh), and both builds of the tracked files, in two different directories, wrote those bytes the same way. So the build in the checkout read something a fresh clone does not have, an ignored or untracked file or an installed package other than the lockfile gives, or it depends on the directory it ran in.
A build in CI or by anyone else writes what the rebuild wrote, not what the checkout holds.
npm ci and npm run build succeed on the tracked files alone, twice, in 45.4 s.
Nothing else was in the tree, which is the state a fresh clone and CI build in, so a build that needs a leftover from an earlier one would have failed here.
